raw_output: {"rationale":"This is iteration 0, so there is no race telemetry or integration feedback yet. I chose a conservative, symmetric platform that should be easy for the Integrator to control. Five sensors at 0.02 m spacing span 0.08 m, wider than the 0.025 m tape, so the line stays visible across bends. Sensors sit 0.05 m ahead of the axle to give lookahead, which helps at speed. The 0.012 m footprint is smaller than the tape width and the spacing, so each sensor reads mostly one zone. A 0.12 m wheel track with 0.03 m wheels gives moderate turning authority without excessive yaw inertia. A 0.8 kg mass with a 0.16 m body length keeps the yaw inertia moderate. The body is 0.12 m wide, so the off-track limit is max(0.06, 0.0125+0.03) = 0.06 m. I expect this to finish the course with a moderate average speed and few line losses.
